verdict.rationale: vLLM documents seamless support for 200+ Hugging Face model architectures, direct loading with trust_remote_code for HF Hub models, and simple pip/uv install plus CLI server startup, making it straightforward for a power-user to pull and run HF models locally. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the actual HF download/run workflow and any documented caveats/limitations users hit in practice.
